Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding outdoor recreation on lands purchased by a private, not-for-profit organization acquired in whole or part with public funds.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to outdoor recreation on lands purchased by aprivate, not-for-profit organization acquired in whole or part withpublic funds; adding a new section to chapter 79A.25 RCW; adding a newsection to chapter 77.12 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 43.30RCW; adding a new section to chapter 43.21A RCW; adding a new sectionto chapter 79A.05 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 90.71 RCW; andcreating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 79A.25 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A private, not-for-profit organization acquiring real propertyunder either (a) or (b) of this subsection may not prohibit or restrictpublic access for purposes of hunting, fishing, trapping, or otheroutdoor recreation on that property beyond any prohibitions orrestrictions in effect immediately prior to acquisition of the propertyby that organization. This section applies to a private,not-for-profit organization acquiring property: (a) Using any funds distributed by or reimbursed from a stateagency, including the office and the boards administered by the office, p. 1 SB 5057the department of natural resources, the department of fish andwildlife, the Puget Sound partnership, the state parks and recreationcommission, and the department of ecology, for purposes of theacquisition through grant programs or other funding mechanisms,including for purposes of salmon recovery funding, estuary restoration,or through the Washington wildlife and recreation program; or (b) Through a transfer from a local or state agency, a tribalgovernment, or the federal government where the property was acquiredusing state funds or any funds provided by or reimbursed from a stateagency. (2) When providing funds for acquisitions by or transferring landsto a private, not-for-profit organization, state agencies must includeconditions consistent with this section as part of the funding oracquisition agreement. (3) When a state or local agency discovers a potential violation ofthis section, the state or local agency shall provide notice andrelevant information to the appropriate committees of the senate andhouse of representatives by the earlier of December 1st of that year orwithin sixty days of the discovery.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall comply with the applicable requirements ofsection 1 of this act.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.30 RCWunder the subchapter heading "Part 5 powers and duties general" toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall comply with the applicable requirements ofsection 1 of this act.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.21A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall comply with the applicable requirements ofsection 1 of this act.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 79A.05 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The commission shall comply with the applicable requirements ofsection 1 of this act.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 90.71 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The partnership shall comply with the applicable requirements ofsection 1 of this act.
Section 1(1) and (3) of this act appliesretroactively to all applicable land transactions since January 1,1962, but in all other respects this act applies prospectively.
